title: One dependency file per object
objective: Derive the .d files from the object list with the suffix-only substitution $(OBJS:.o=.d).
hint: $(OBJS:.o=.d) swaps the ending of every word in the list: ./build/hello.cpp.o becomes ./build/hello.cpp.d.

steps.description: the two spellings of the dependency list agree
every object has a matching .d file, in any order
steps.stdout:
dependency file: ./build/./src/main.c.d
dependency file: ./build/./src/moduleA/thing.c.d
dependency file: ./build/./src/util/greet.cpp.d
